snippet.title: Yakuza 0 | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Yakuza 0 is now available on Xbox One Game Pass and Windows 10!

We’re excited for Xbox fans to finally experience the drama, extreme action, and hilarious minigames and sub-stories of the critically acclaimed, genre-defying Yakuza series.

https://yakuza.sega.com/project/yakuza-0/
